sophia_p: Follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem + pattern analysis: Ops flagged this as a recurring pattern (weekend burst + cache cold start). We should (1) add deterministic regression cases, (2) add a recurring weekly "regression canary" job, (3) expand promptset evals for the edge cases, and (4) schedule a monthly chaos drill. Who takes what?

rahul_k: I can take the weekly regression canary. Idea: lightweight job that runs every Monday 02:00 UTC against staging with 5 warmup flows + 100 synthetic short/long prefixes. If it fails > 2 runs in a row, create an automated PING to the oncall and open PM-FU ticket. ETA to wire up: 04/28.

miguel: I'll own deterministic regression cases. Plan: tests/eviction_pattern/ with 8 cases that mirror the weekend burst traces. Add a small harness that can replay the exact sequence; include seed files and expected KV-miss thresholds. PR by 04/25.

samir: I'll expand the eval promptsets to capture repeated-token loops and truncated streaming. Will add both token-level and sequence-level metrics and a new "kv_miss_regression" metric tied to the promptset. PR + initial run by 04/23.

dina_oncall: I'll schedule the monthly chaos drill (staging) and include the weekly canary in the oncall checklist. Chaos plan: k6 spike 20m at 2x, then drain+reboot 1 GPU worker mid-spike. Proposed first drill 05/03 09:00 PT. I'll post the runbook to #eng-oncall once dates firm.

qa-jen: I'll own gating and CI automation. Add a `canary-evict` job that runs weekly and blocks merges when the regression canary trips on a PR. Need Miguel's test names and Samir's golden outputs to pin thresholds. Will also add a flaky detection rule.

incident-bot: created TASK-PLAT-1337: "eviction-pattern regression + weekly canary" assigned to miguel.

sophia_p: Owner recap for PM-FU-5300: miguel -> regressions (TASK-PLAT-1337), rahul -> weekly canary, samir -> eval promptset/metrics (EVAL-720), dina_oncall -> monthly chaos drill (TASK-OPS-700), qa-jen -> CI/gating. Please add PR links to PM-FU-5300 as you open them.

miguel: Note: I'll include a small local replay command in the README: `python tools/replay_trace.py traces/weekend_burst_2026-03-14.json` and a pytest quick-run: `pytest tests/eviction_pattern -k burst_repro -q`.

rahul_k: Canary run snippet for ops infra: `k6 run --vus 50 --duration 10m scripts/canary_kv_spike.js` with real warmup keys. I'll add alert hooks to create PM-FU-5300 subtasks automatically.

samir: Small request: QA wants both strict and fuzzy golden outputs. I'll add exact-match examples for deterministic flows and fuzzy thresholds for noisy cases.

qa-jen: Sounds good. I'll gate merges on the canary and add a dashboard tile that shows canary pass/fail over the last 8 weeks. If the pass rate drops below 85% we escalate to infra.

dina_oncall: I'll also run the chaos drill in staging with load and capture KV miss ratio, p95/p99 and replay logs. We'll attach the artifacts to PM-FU-5300.

sophia_p: Perfect. I'll run weekly check-ins on PM-FU-5300 until all tasks are closed. Closing thread unless someone needs more time. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: linked TASK-PLAT-1337 -> PM-FU-5300, EVAL-720, TASK-OPS-700."
